services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Complete solutions that turn your business into a results machine

items.title: Automations & AI
items.description: Smart workflows running 24/7: WhatsApp, email, CRM, virtual agents and AI integrations.
items.fullDescription: We build custom automation workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks and scale your customer service. Our AI agents are trained specifically for your business, answering questions, qualifying leads and scheduling meetings automatically — 24/7.
features: Smart chatbots for WhatsApp, Instagram and website
Email marketing automation with dynamic segmentation
Virtual agents with generative AI (GPT, Claude)
No-code automations with Make, n8n and Zapier

items.title: Marketing & Content
items.description: Posts, campaigns, blogs and social media with consistency and strategy.
items.fullDescription: We plan and execute your digital presence with strategic content that builds authority and drives conversions. From social media posts to full paid traffic campaigns, we handle the entire customer journey with persuasive copy and scroll-stopping design.
features: Monthly editorial calendar with ready-to-post content
Paid traffic management (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
Persuasive copywriting for ads and landing pages

items.title: Websites & Landing Pages
items.description: Modern sites built with Lovable or Webflow, focused on performance and full integration.
items.fullDescription: We create websites and landing pages that aren't just beautiful — they're conversion machines. We use the most modern platforms to deliver fast, responsive projects fully integrated with your sales funnel and automation tools.
features: Development in Lovable, Webflow or custom code
CRM, WhatsApp and marketing tools integration

items.title: Branding & Creatives
items.description: Visual identity, carousels, 3D renders and designs ready to engage and convert.
items.fullDescription: We develop memorable visual identities and graphic materials that position your brand as a market reference. From logo to post templates, we create a cohesive visual system that conveys professionalism and instant recognition.

items.title: Paid Traffic
items.description: Strategic campaigns on Meta Ads, Google Ads and LinkedIn to attract qualified leads.
items.fullDescription: We create and manage paid traffic campaigns focused on measurable results. From campaign setup to continuous optimization, we ensure every dollar invested works to bring qualified leads and increase your sales.

items.title: Social Media
items.description: Complete management of Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn with strategic content and organic growth.
items.fullDescription: We take over full management of your social media with a strategic approach. We create engaging content, build community and turn followers into loyal customers through a consistent and authentic digital presence.

items.title: Digital Consulting
items.description: Complete diagnosis and personalized strategic plan to accelerate your digital growth.
items.fullDescription: We conduct a deep diagnosis of your business and market to create a tailored strategic plan. We identify opportunities, define priorities and chart a clear roadmap for you to achieve your goals in a structured way.

items.title: Web Systems
items.description: Custom web applications, dashboards and internal systems to optimize operations.
items.fullDescription: We develop custom web applications that solve specific problems in your business. From BI dashboards to internal management systems, we create solutions that automate processes and improve decision-making.
